halaman.script: Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. The front door area of a simple Indonesian village house at dusk: a wooden front door, a small doormat, a potted plant beside the door, warm yellow porch light Dimas, a small 9-year-old child 128 cm tall, 9-year-old Indonesian Muslim boy, 128 cm tall with a child's proportions, his head reaching Kakek Hasan's chest, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short spiky black hair, mustard-yellow long-sleeved koko shirt, black trousers, blue rubber sandals. Dimas stands on the doormat in front of the closed wooden front door, his back to the camera. Dimas pushes the wooden door open with his right hand and steps forward through the doorway into the house. Camera in front of the house door at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Kakek Hasan, a grown adult 166 cm tall, 68-year-old Indonesian Muslim grandfather, 166 cm tall, slim, slightly stooped, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short neat white beard along the jaw, white knitted peci cap, light grey long-sleeved koko shirt, dark brown checkered sarong to the ankles, brown leather sandals. Kakek Hasan stands upright beside the potted plant in front of the open door, facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle. Kakek Hasan raises his right hand and waves it gently once toward the doorway. Camera in front of the house at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Dimas, a small 9-year-old child 128 cm tall, 9-year-old Indonesian Muslim boy, 128 cm tall with a child's proportions, his head reaching Kakek Hasan's chest, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short spiky black hair, mustard-yellow long-sleeved koko shirt, black trousers, blue rubber sandals. Dimas stands in the open doorway facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, his hands at his sides. Dimas walks forward two steps onto the doormat and stops. Only after he stops, he tilts his head to the side. Camera in the doorway at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Kakek Hasan, a grown adult 166 cm tall, 68-year-old Indonesian Muslim grandfather, 166 cm tall, slim, slightly stooped, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short neat white beard along the jaw, white knitted peci cap, light grey long-sleeved koko shirt, dark brown checkered sarong to the ankles, brown leather sandals. Kakek Hasan stands upright beside the potted plant facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, both hands resting together in front of him. Kakek Hasan raises his right index finger once. Camera in front of the house at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

balon.teks: Sebelum masuk rumah, ucapkan salam dulu. Biar rumah kita penuh berkah.
